increment_paragraph: **LOOP-REACQUISITION-LEAK-ACCUSATION** (round 26, gateway rule 42; USER DECISION 2026-11-07, verbatim: "Register four as implementation cards"): the per-generation QCORE_LEAK_WITNESS census on rd_kafka_snappy_java_uncompress and rd_kafka_sasl_safe_string (the two rows whose leaks sit on a `loop re-acquisition` refusal) confirms the generation join for snappy :1680, :1694, :1712, :1721 (the current generation released, escaped or refined away; only earlier generations reach the exit) and refutes it for :1648, :1660, :1701 and scram :249 (current-generation witnesses on the path-insensitive pass guard and the chained assignment). Card-local current-route check on the two units: snappy loses exactly the four confirmed leaves and stays provisional Unsafe, nothing else moves; prediction no status move on corpus, system and slice. The census also shows the settled exits reproduce none of the eight leaves (C02-P-ALIAS -LEAK-ORDER). Lean QCore.LoopReacquisitionLeak (15 theorems); fixtures for a true leak inside the refused loop (still Unsafe) and loops without re-acquisition (unchanged). Nothing is presented as an upstream defect.
